title: Gift of Snowfall
body:
Description

The Gift of Snowfall was an item available for purchase at Santa's Workshop for 50,000 Snowflakes. It was also obtainable on several days of the Christmas Advent Calendar.

Like all other presents, it will open when the event ends. (December 25th, 2024)

When the present is opened if gives snowfall a boxed item that when placed makes snow particles in a area

Appearance

This item's gift box uses the Active Gift of Chill as its model.
